description: Remove one trip from a Nomads.com member's own history, e.g. a duplicate or a superseded entry. Authenticated as the member (signed in through the connector with OAuth or an Authorization header, or username + personal key from https://nomads.com/settings). Needs the trip_id (returned by get_trips). Only the authenticated member's own trips can be removed.

key.description: From https://nomads.com/settings. Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

username.description: Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

name: remove_trip
